complementarity_example.interpretation: nonzero pair interaction arises from exact constraint algebra, not fitted reward weight

higher_difference: Delta_T R = sum_{S superset T} c_S prod_{j in S\T} b_j
mobius_coefficient_recovery: c_T = (Delta_T R) evaluated with all remaining b=0
multilinear_normal_form: R(b)=sum_{S subseteq [m]} c_S prod_{i in S} b_i after reduction b_i^2=b_i
single_difference: Delta_i R = R(b_i=1)-R(b_i=0) = sum_{S contains i} c_S prod_{j in S\{i}} b_j
